<translated_code>
n_coins_input = input()
n_coins_parts = n_coins_input.strip().split()
n = int(n_coins_parts[0])
coins = int(n_coins_parts[1])

vals_input = input()
vals = list(map(int, vals_input.strip().split()))

oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
cuts = 0
diffs = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    val = vals[i]
    if val % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if oddCount == evenCount:
        nextVal = vals[i + 1]
        difference = abs(nextVal - val)
        diffs.append(difference)

diffs.sort()

for d in diffs:
    if d <= coins:
        coins -= d
        cuts += 1
    else:
        break

print(cuts)
</translated_code>
